task: Create a pharmaceutical research presentation. 12 slides: Slide 1: 'Drug Discovery Pipeline - Compound XR-7'. Slide 2: research timeline (horizontal arrow with 5 phase markers: Discovery, Preclinical, Phase I, Phase II, Phase III). Slide 3: molecular structure placeholder (hexagonal shapes connected in a ring). Slide 4: mechanism of action flow diagram. Slide 5: preclinical results table. Slide 6: Phase I trial design diagram (patient flow). Slide 7: efficacy data bar chart. Slide 8: safety profile table with color-coded severity. Slide 9: pharmacokinetics curve chart. Slide 10: competitive landscape comparison table. Slide 11: regulatory pathway flowchart. Slide 12: next milestones and budget. Use medical blue (#0277BD) and white with green (#4CAF50) for positive results. Save as 'Drug_Pipeline.pptx' on the Desktop. The file to work on is /home/user/impress_wf_071.pptx. Name the shapes so their kind is identifiable: the slide-2 timeline arrow's name must contain 'Arrow', each slide-3 hexagon's name 'Hexagon', and in the slide-11 flowchart each decision shape's name 'Diamond' and each process box a rounded rectangle whose name contains 'Rounded'. Save the result at /home/user/Desktop/Drug_Pipeline.pptx.
